messages:
Maria (CSM): Quick heads-up — PulseClinic onboarding showing a big embedding burst this week. Renewal in 6 weeks and we need a tight QBR ask + remediation plan. Anyone have a 7-day spend forecast?
Sam (FinOps): pulling numbers now. Do we have avg tokens/day and peak embedding calls?
Vinh (Onboard): avg ~1.2M tokens/day last month, spike to ~6.8M yesterday after the batch import. Embeddings accounted for ~82% of the token burn.
Emma (AE): renewal touchpoint scheduled wk of 5/4. They want predictable pricing — can't surprise them with a bill shock.
Maria (CSM): priority: 1) quick forecast 2) guardrails to avoid surprise 3) suggested customer messaging for QBR
Sam (FinOps): Forecast (rough): next 7d baseline ~8M tokens/day if import continues, but with throttling it's ~2.1M/day. If we assume 50% retention of new calls, ballpark 18–22M tokens/day peak week.
Vinh (Onboard): we can implement short-term limits on import workers and enable per-route rate-limits. That reduces initial surge but may delay ingestion. Is that acceptable to product?
Emma (AE): they'll accept slower ingestion if we promise not to exceed an agreed spend cap. Can we present a suggested cap + soft alerts?
Sam (FinOps): yes. Recommend: soft alert at 60% of monthly credit, hard cap at 85%. Also propose a short free credit cushion for onboarding (one-time) to smooth burn.
Maria (CSM): drafted message for QBR + customer nudge. Need numbers to include.
ops-bot: Alert: PulseClinic embedding-rate exceeded 500 req/min at 2026-03-20T14:12:03Z. Current 10-min avg = 620 req/min.
Vinh (Onboard): ops-bot noted the same. I throttled the import workers by 70% at 14:20 — throughput down ~65% now.
Sam (FinOps): Pushing a quick chart to the QBR deck. Can someone confirm token price profile used for estimates? Are they on hosted standard tier or dedicated?
Maria (CSM): they're on hosted standard (metered). Current unit price = $0.0008 / 1k tokens (embedding model variant).
Sam (FinOps): ok. Using that I get expected incremental spend from the import ~ $9.6k over 7 days at current surge. With throttling and cushion, estimate ~$3.2k incremental.
Emma (AE): propose we offer a 50% onboarding credit up to $2k and set the soft alert threshold in their workspace. That should buy time for negotiation at renewal.
Vinh (Onboard): I'll add per-route rate-limit config and a KV cache for embeddings to reduce duplicate calls. Quick config I used:
```
route: /v1/embeddings
rate_limit: 200rpm
burst: 50
cache: true
cache_ttl: 86400
```
Maria (CSM): love that. Can someone add the above snippet to the enablement playbook? Also need recommended phrasing for the customer nudge (short).
Sam (FinOps): recommended nudge: "Heads-up: we've detected a high-volume ingestion for your account. We've applied temporary throttling and added an onboarding credit to avoid bill shock. We'll review usage together in the upcoming QBR and recommend long-term guardrails."
Emma (AE): fine to send. I'll coordinate the credit approval with finance.
Maria (CSM): action list: @Sam finalize forecast numbers + deck fig, @Vinh apply per-route limits + add cache, @Emma confirm credit approval, I'll send the nudge and prep QBR slide.
Vinh (Onboard): done on limits and cache; monitoring now. Throughput stable and token burn trending down.
ops-bot: Notice: Billing alert scheduled — soft threshold at 60% reached in projected 3 days.
Sam (FinOps): I'll update the deck with two scenarios (no throttle vs throttle + cushion). Need final numbers by EOD.
Maria (CSM): thanks team. quick follow-up: let's keep the customer messaging optimistic and emphasize predictability. :rocket:
Emma (AE): will draft nudge and send for review before outreach. :thumbsup:
Maria (CSM): closing thread for now, will reopen if numbers change.
